title: reference script whose constant is an empty list of BLS G1 elements
description: The output carries the reference script (program 1.1.0 (con (list bls12_381_G1_element) [])). The BLS type tag decodes and the empty list never reads an element value, so the script is well-formed, as on the Haskell node. Preprod block 130138398.449b3e3b contains a production example (tx 4de93f45, output #2, script 0ba0ad6b).
